raw_segments.text: Cordelia, good my lord, you have begot me, bred me, loved me.
I return those duties back as a right fit, obey you, love you, and most honor you.
Why have my sisters husbands if they say they love you all?
Happily, when I shall wed, that lord whose hand must take my plight shall carry half
my love with him, half my care and duty.
Sure, I shall never marry like my sisters to love my father all.
